name: LDROBOT
summary: LDROBOT (Shenzhen LDROBOT Co., Ltd.; Shenzhen LeDong Robotics Co., Ltd.) is a Shenzhen-based robotics company founded in 2017. It develops perception components and navigation technology for physical robots, including rotating DTOF and triangulation LiDAR, solid-state line sensors, ultrasonic sensors, multi-camera vision modules and developer kits. Its manufacturer documentation also covers embedded navigation boards and depth-camera modules. These components support mapping, navigation, obstacle detection and other perception tasks in household, commercial, industrial and research robots. The company also operates a robotic lawn-mower business, which is outside this component acquisition.
categories: Robot Control Boards and Computing Components
